svg.text: Three cycles of 30 s at 1 m; crew 10 m away; wind 3 m/s or less; ballast fitted.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Throttle up until light on the gear and back down before the first lift; motors below 45 °C between cycles.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Pass: 30 s stable, attitude error under 15°, lift output under 60 %, vibration under 30, tethers never taut.
